description: This file contains unit tests for the Android port and driver in the WebKit layout tests framework, including mock setup, test cases for command line, prompt reading, tombstone handling, and multiple driver instances.

classes.name: AndroidPortTest
classes.description: Unit test case for Android port functionalities, including build check, sys deps, driver support, child processes, HTTP server requirement, and timeouts.

classes.name: ChromiumAndroidDriverTest
classes.description: Test case for Chromium Android driver command line and prompt reading.

classes.name: ChromiumAndroidDriverTwoDriversTest
classes.description: Test for multiple driver instances with correct serial numbers.

classes.name: ChromiumAndroidTwoPortsTest
classes.description: Test for driver command line options passing through multiple ports.

classes.name: ChromiumAndroidDriverTombstoneTest
classes.description: Test for handling tombstone crash logs, including missing files, permission issues, invalid formats, and valid file reading.

methods.name: mock_devices
methods.description: Creates a list of mock device objects with specific serials for testing.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes mock patches for device and battery utilities before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Stops mock patches after each test.

methods.name: test_check_build
methods.description: Tests the build check method in the Android port.

methods.name: test_check_sys_deps
methods.description: Placeholder for sys deps check test.

methods.name: test_non_content_shell_driver
methods.description: Ensures only content_shell driver is supported.

methods.name: test_default_child_processes
methods.description: Verifies child process count depends on device count.

methods.name: test_requires_http_server
methods.description: Checks if HTTP server is required.

methods.name: test_default_timeout_ms
methods.description: Verifies default timeouts for different configurations.

methods.name: test_path_to_apache_config_file
methods.description: Tests path to apache config file method.

methods.name: test_cmd_line
methods.description: Verifies command line for starting shell.

methods.name: test_two_drivers
methods.description: Checks correct serials for multiple drivers.

methods.name: test_options_with_two_ports
methods.description: Verifies command line options passing in multiple ports.

methods.name: test_no_tombstones_found
methods.description: Ensures proper handling when no tombstone files are found.

methods.name: test_insufficient_tombstone_permission
methods.description: Handles permission denied error in tombstone retrieval.

methods.name: test_invalid_tombstone_list
methods.description: Handles missing or malformed tombstone entries.

methods.name: test_read_valid_tombstone_file
methods.description: Returns contents of the most recent valid tombstone file.
